## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- ImageMetadataEngine.analyze
- computes aspect_ratio 16:9 exactly
- computes density_bytes_per_pixel exactly
- has_gps=false when no coordinates supplied
- has_gps=true when both lat and lon present
- rejects gps_lat outside [-90, 90]
